exposure: waiting for the onset of spontaneous labor within 48 h of tPROM
Prelabor rupture of fetal membranes at term (tPROM)
prelabor rupture of fetal membranes at term (tPROM)
cohort: 6032 women with no obstetric risk factors other than tPROM
finding: A policy of expectant management for up to 48 hours in women with tPROM is associated with low rates of maternal and neonatal morbidity and a lower likelihood of cesarean section compared to immediate induction of labor.
mod_finding: Women with term PROM who waited for spontaneous labor had lower odds of cesarean delivery compared to those whose labor was induced.
